escape.text: The Terran patrol ship has taken serious damage. Its engines flare as it attempts to disengage and jump away.

surrender.text: The Terran patrol ship is barely holding together. They transmit a surrender offer, promising supplies if you let them retreat.

event.text: The patrol transfers a small cache of supplies, then powers down its weapons and retreats.
You reject the offer and continue the attack.

destroyed.text: The Terran patrol ship breaks apart under your final volley. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the patrol crew neutralized, you strip the ship for useful supplies.

escape.text: The Terran scout throws everything into its engines and begins charging its FTL drive.

surrender.text: The scout is barely holding together. Its crew transmits a frantic surrender offer, promising supplies if you let them live.

event.text: The scout transfers what supplies it can spare and powers down its weapons.

choice.text: Refuse. They cannot be allowed to report your position.

event.text: You reject the offer and continue the attack.

destroyed.text: The Terran scout breaks apart before it can escape. You collect what little salvage remains.

surrender.text: The second Terran assault ship is badly damaged. With the attack broken, its captain offers supplies in exchange for being allowed to withdraw.

event.text: The assault ship powers down its weapons and transfers a cache of supplies before limping away.
You reject the offer and continue the attack.

destroyed.text: The second Terran assault ship breaks apart under your final volley. With the attack force destroyed, you salvage the wreckage.

deadCrew.text: With the second assault crew neutralized, you secure the ship and strip it for supplies.

escape.text: The ambush ship has taken heavy damage. Its engines flare as it attempts to withdraw before you can finish it off.

destroyed.text: The Terran ambusher breaks apart under your final volley. You salvage the remains of the attack ship.

deadCrew.text: With the ambush crew neutralized, you secure the ship and strip it of everything useful.

destroyed.text: The Terran ship is destroyed. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the Terran crew defeated, you search the ship and secure its supplies.

escape.text: The transport throws full power into its engines and begins charging its FTL drive.

surrender.text: The transport's hull buckles under the damage. Its captain offers a shipment of raw scrap if you allow them to disengage.

event.text: The transport transfers the promised scrap and begins powering down its weapons.

choice.text: Refuse. Seize the cargo by force.

event.text: You reject the offer and continue the attack.

destroyed.text: The transport breaks apart before you can secure its cargo. You salvage what little survives the explosion.

deadCrew.text: With the transport crew neutralized, you board the vessel and recover its intact cargo records and supplies.
